## What it is

An asymmetric reconstruction exercise with its reference coordinates offset from the origin. The L-shaped bracket has two unequal-position base holes, one side hole through the upright, and a small locator notch at the near edge.

## Design notes

Identity alignment is intentional. The reference bounds begin at x = 12mm and y = -7mm, so centering the mesh would conceal a frame error. The default analytic model preserves that source frame and reconstructs the holes as cylinders rather than polygonal openings.

The `missing_locator` variant fills a 2 × 4mm edge notch. Its affected area is small enough that aggregate coverage can remain high, but the worst-region evidence must still identify a deviation above the 0.12mm tolerance.

## Don't

Do not center or scale the reference. Do not raise the tolerance to hide the missing locator. Do not replace the analytic holes with polygons that trace the STL facets.

## Changelog

Added an offset, asymmetric regression exercise with holes and a deliberately missing functional locator.
